turn_guard.init: results/policy_mjlab_guard/model_5997.pt (stage-2 guard; the footwork guard's model_7496.pt was lost, so this run also learns the footwork changes)

outer_loops: hold-your-spot fixed at hold_deadband [0.25, 0.08] (as both shipped footwork policies); turn command off / on / deadband [0.35, 0.1] chosen on hard-tier validation by the existing rule: most bouts up and within 1 m among the settings within one bout (1/64) of the best survival (scripts/face_ab.py --val).
ship_rule: A candidate replaces the shipped footwork policy with the same arm pose only if, on validation only, all hold: (1) CPU MuJoCo turn response (scripts/face_ab.py turn_response, no opponent) min(|w(+0.8)|, |w(-0.8)|) >= 0.25 rad/s and >= 1.5x the shipped policy's; (2) hard-tier validation survival >= shipped - 1/64 and up-and-within-1 m >= shipped - 1/64, each with its chosen turn setting; (3) standard-tier validation survival >= shipped - 1/80.
test: reported once, for both candidates, after the decision; never used to choose.
